class.name: IfcBuildingSystem
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : A building system is a group by which building elements are group according to a common function within the building. HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x4. The group IfcBuildingSystem defines the occurrence of a specialized system for use within the context of a building and finishing fabric. Important functionalities for the description of a building system are derived from supert
